title: Error lineage explorer and SLO-mapped views for inference platform
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create an "Error Lineage Explorer" and a set of SLO-mapped dashboard views that make it trivial for oncall and engineers to trace an observed client error or latency spike back through the request path (API gateway -> routing -> model shard -> runtime) and the contributing failure class (timeout, overload, model runtime exception, serialization error, HTTP/gRPC status). This work ties tracing hooks, enriched metrics/log pipelines, and console dashboards to provide fast MTTI (mean time to identification) and reduce operator toil. Deliverables include canonical error_code normalization, span/span-attribute conventions, ingestion pipeline transforms, dashboard UI views aligned to SLOs, and an initial runbook for common patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical error_key field exists for all inference spans and logs (one of TIMEOUT | OVERLOAD | MODEL_ERROR | SERIALIZATION | TRANSPORT) and is populated for >=95% of error events
Tracing instrumentation emits a "lineage_id" that can be used to join traces, logs, and metric slices for a single request end-to-end

Console provides three SLO-mapped views: 1) 99th latency slices with error overlays, 2) Error lineage explorer that shows recent samples and their root cause paths, 3) Team-level error heatmap filtered by model and region
Dashboard panels include links to original spans/trace, the associated request payload (redacted), and the most recent model inference log for the same lineage_id
Alert rules updated to reference unified error_key (so alerts are grouped by failure class) and paging noise is reduced by at least 25% in the first week post-deploy
Runbook created with playbook steps for the top three failure classes (TIMEOUT, OVERLOAD, MODEL_ERROR) and reviewed by oncall and SRE
tasks: Design error_key taxonomy and document mapping from HTTP/gRPC codes, runtime exceptions, and internal retry outcomes
Add lineage_id and error_key span attributes in OpenTelemetry SDK wrappers used by API gateway, router, and runtime exec path
Update log ingestion transform (Kafka -> transform -> ClickHouse) to normalize error_key and attach lineage_id to logs and metrics
Create Grafana/Console dashboards: SLO-mapped latency view, error lineage explorer UI mock, team heatmap
Implement storage of a short trace sample (trace_id, lineage_id, root_span_summary) in observability indices for fast drilldown
Add unit/integration tests that assert presence of lineage_id and error_key for synthetic failure scenarios
Run internal canary on a small subset of traffic and measure noise/false-positive rate for new alerts
Publish runbook, update oncall rotation, and add dashboard links to post-incident pages
decisions: Use OpenTelemetry as canonical tracing API and add two attributes: telemetry.lineage_id and telemetry.error_key
Normalize downstream gRPC codes and HTTP status into four primary failure buckets plus OTHER for unknowns
Store short trace summaries in ClickHouse for sub-second dashboard lookups instead of querying full traces from Jaeger on every drilldown
Use existing Kafka topic observability-events.v2 and add a lightweight transform rather than introducing a new topic to avoid topological churn
